name: Rajgad

trails.name: Pali Darwaja route
trails.note: Longer but steadier; wide steps near the top lead through Pali Darwaja onto Padmavati Machi.

trails.name: Chor Darwaja route
trails.note: Steep, with rock patches and railings near Chor Darwaja. Avoid when wet or with beginners.

water: Padmavati lake and cisterns on Padmavati Machi; treat or filter before drinking.
Few or no stalls on the way up — carry 3 litres, more in summer.

landmarks.name: Padmavati Machi
landmarks.note: Main plateau with the Padmavati temple, the lake and the old Rajsadar.

landmarks.name: Saibai's samadhi
landmarks.note: Samadhi of Maharani Saibai, on Padmavati Machi.

landmarks.name: Suvela Machi
landmarks.note: Long eastern spur; look for the natural rock arch (Nedhe).

landmarks.name: Sanjivani Machi
landmarks.note: Western spur with layered fortification walls.

landmarks.name: Balekilla
landmarks.note: The citadel at the very top; the final climb is exposed, use the railings.

safety: This is a full-day climb; start early or plan to stay overnight on Padmavati Machi.
The Balekilla climb is exposed — skip it in strong wind or rain.
Phone signal is patchy on the machis; tell someone your plan before you start.

returnTransport.note: Limited state transport (ST) buses to the base villages via Nasrapur/Velhe; most hikers use their own vehicle. Confirm the last bus locally.

en: It served as the capital of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj's kingdom for about 25 years before the capital moved to Raigad.
The fort has three machis (Padmavati, Suvela, Sanjivani) around a central citadel, the Balekilla.
Maharani Saibai's samadhi is on Padmavati Machi.
Chhatrapati Rajaram Maharaj was born on Rajgad in 1670.
mr: राजगड सुमारे पंचवीस वर्षे छत्रपती शिवाजी महाराजांच्या स्वराज्याची राजधानी होता.
पद्मावती, सुवेळा आणि संजीवनी या तीन माच्या आणि मध्ये सर्वात वर बालेकिल्ला आहे.
महाराणी सईबाई यांची समाधी पद्मावती माचीवर आहे.
